name: PlaywrightTestsPage

states.name: Page Purpose
states.description: The Playwright Test Builder enables users to create browser automation tests using Playwright. These tests serve as powerful verification steps in workflows, allowing AI-driven automation to validate that web applications behave correctly after changes. Users write TypeScript/JavaScript test code, run tests, and view results including failure screenshots.

states.name: Test Authoring Goals
states.description: Users need a productive test authoring experience with code editing, syntax highlighting, and quick access to common Playwright patterns. The editor should make it easy to write assertions that verify page content, element state, and user interaction outcomes.

states.name: Test Execution Goals
states.description: Users need to run tests directly from the builder to validate their test code works correctly before incorporating tests into workflows. Test execution should provide clear pass/fail results with detailed error messages and failure screenshots.

states.name: Test Management Goals
states.description: Users need to manage their test library over time — deleting obsolete tests, updating tests as the application evolves, and organizing tests for easy discovery when building workflows.

description: Playwright Test Builder page — where users create, edit, and manage Playwright browser automation tests that serve as verification steps in workflows
